agent.first_message: Hi {{foreman_first_name}}, this is the Schreiber Excavating automated assistant. This call is recorded. What do you need?

end_call.name: end_call
end_call.description: End the call. Use it right after the rejection line when the caller is not on the Roster, and when the foreman is done.

transfer_to_number.name: transfer_to_number
transfer_to_number.description: Put the Foreman through to the Office Line. Use it only after transfer_to_office (or, in an Emergency, after the safety line and start_emergency) and after saying "Connecting you to the office now."

transfers.condition: The Foreman asks to talk to the office or to a person (for example "let me talk to someone", "get me the office", "put me through"), or accepts your offer to put him through to the office; or an Emergency (danger reported), after the safety line and start_emergency.

need.description: What the foreman said they need on this call (for example "tri-axle dump trucks" or "move the excavator"), in their words, whether or not it was confirmed or submitted. Leave empty if they asked for nothing, only checked on an existing request, or only asked for the office.

job_spoken.description: The job the need is for, exactly as the foreman or the agent's read-back named it (for example "Route 104 Widening"). Leave empty if no job was named.

category.description: The category of the need. Use Other if none fits. Leave empty if there is no need.

quantity.description: How many of the need the foreman asked for, as a number. Leave empty if no number was said.

unit.description: The unit of the quantity as said (for example "trucks", "loads", "tons"). Leave empty if none was said.

needed_by_spoken.description: When the foreman needs it, in their words (for example "tomorrow at 7 AM"). Leave empty if not said.
